r0.why: Halogenated hydrocarbons of C, H, Cl, F (1), volatile derivatives of methane/ethane/propane (2), R-12 most common, Freon refrigerant (3-4).

r1.why: Volatile but less than parent alkanes (10), halide polarity and intermolecular interactions (11), solvents/refrigerants (14), less flammable than methane (15), low toxicity/reactivity/flammability drive use (18).

r2.why: Refrigerants, propellants, fire suppression, solvents (5), permutations examined and mostly commercialized (19), blowing agents, medicinal propellants, degreasers (21), chlorodifluoromethane to TFE/Teflon (22).

r3.why: Add-90 rule (29), digits carbon/hydrogen/fluorine (30), leftover bonds chlorine (31), CFC-12 worked example to CCl2F2 (33).

r4.why: Long-lived Cl radical catalyzing ozone to O2 (35-36), UV-B reaching surface (37), bromine more efficient and regulated (38), Montreal phase-out (39), HFC/HFO replacements R-134a, R-1234yf (6).

r5.why: Impacts beyond ozone (40), IR bands trap heat (41), C-F/C-Cl bands at 7.8-15.3 um atmospheric window (42), super greenhouse effect from CFCs and unreactive fluorine gases (43).
